title: fix(approvals): the approval e-mail link and the action page's inbox link open the Console under its mount
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8UqWLrzTYpuat8L5eLdf2c)_
Fixes #34862
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批人点开审批邮件里的「打开审批」链接,以前在默认部署上看到的是一个“找不到”的错误页,现在直接打开控制台里的这条审批请求;审批完成页上的「打开审批中心」链接也一样修好了。
- 属于审批与通知的整体工作:每位审批人收到的邮件唯一的链接是坏的,这次把它修好。
- 出错的话,审批人点邮件链接仍会落到错误页或错误路径,但不影响在控制台内直接审批;本改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The approval e-mail's link (`approvalUrl`, built in `notify()`) and the action-link result page's "Open the Approvals Inbox" link now carry the Console's mount. The mount is not written in plugin-approvals: it is read from the auth service's Console page composer, `getConsoleUrl` (`AuthManager.getConsolePageUrl`, which reads `AuthConfig.uiBasePath`, default `/_console`). That is the composer the auth e-mails and the mention e-mail (`plugin-audit`) already use, so the approval links now follow the same one setting.

- `public-base-url.ts`: new `consolePageLink(publicBaseUrl, composer, pagePath)`. The origin is `publicBaseUrl` (#30509's no-guess origin rule is unchanged; the composer's own origin is dropped). Only the composer's PATH is taken, minus any base path the two share, so a sub-path deployment is not prefixed twice. No composer, a composer that throws, or one that answers no URL gives no mount: the e-mail link is then the one built before, and the inbox link is `BASE/system/approvals`.
- `approvals-plugin.ts`: reads `ctx.getService('auth').getConsoleUrl` lazily at link time (the same reader `audit-plugin.ts` uses), and passes it to the service. The raw-app action-page mount builds the inbox href through the same function.
- `approval-service.ts`: `ApprovalServiceOptions.getConsoleUrl` (optional, additive). `approvalUrl` = `consolePageLink(publicBaseUrl, getConsoleUrl, actionUrl)`. The action page's inbox link moves from the origin-relative `/system/approvals` to `BASE/_console/system/approvals` (relative `/_console/system/approvals` when no base resolves; `BASE/system/approvals` with no mount to read). `handleActionPage` and the plugin's raw-app door build it through the same function, so the two action-page doors still answer the same bytes.
- `action-link-pages.ts`: `renderResultPage` takes an optional `inboxHref` (default: the bare route, as before). `APPROVALS_INBOX_PATH` names the route.
- The in-app `actionUrl` (`/system/approvals?request=ID`) is unchanged: the Console routes on it.

Files outside the claim's named surface, named before editing: `approvals-plugin.ts` (the wiring), `public-base-url.ts` and `public-base-url.test.ts` (the helper and its pins). The one source of truth used is `AuthConfig.uiBasePath`, through the auth service's `getConsoleUrl`. No `packages/spec/**` change and no new export; the one public-surface change is the optional `ApprovalServiceOptions.getConsoleUrl` member.

## Measured hops (real `os dev` boot, the showcase, which runs `serve --dev`)

Boot: `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 38617`, `OS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:38617`, SMTP pointed at a local sink (`OS_EMAIL_PROVIDER=smtp`, `OS_MAIL_SMTP_HOST=127.0.0.1`, `OS_MAIL_SMTP_SECURE=false`), Console built (`pnpm console:build`, the `console-static` plugin loaded). Trigger: sign in as the seeded admin and retitle the "Q3 field-ops rollout" announcement, which opens `showcase_dynamic_approval` (`approval.requested` to the admin). The URL was read from the e-mail the sink received.

<details><summary>Before (origin/main a5a5312ff)</summary>

- E-mail: `Open the approval: http://localhost:38617/system/approvals?request=areq_d3e65840-cc6b-43cf-877c-a2b5402aab42`
- `GET` that URL, anonymous: `404`, `application/json`, `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}`, no `Location`.
- Same URL signed in, following redirects: `404`, 0 redirects, the same JSON. Chromium: one navigation, `404`, page text is that JSON.
- Action-link page inbox link `/system/approvals`: `404`.
- Control: the same path under the mount, `/_console/system/approvals?request=...`: `200 text/html` with the base href set to the mount; in Chromium it opens the request ("Q3 field-ops rollout", Pending, Approve / Reject).
</details>

<details><summary>After (this branch, plugin-approvals rebuilt)</summary>

- E-mail: `Open the approval: http://localhost:38617/_console/system/approvals?request=areq_9dac833e-7dad-48d7-bb38-4c6c8b6b82cd`
- `GET` anonymous: `200 text/html`. Signed in, following redirects: `200`, 0 redirects, the base href is the mount.
- Chromium: one navigation, `200`, then the Console routes to `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_approval_request/record/areq_9dac833e-...`, which shows the request (title, Pending, Lead Review, Approve / Reject).
- `GET /api/v1/approvals/act?token=not-a-token`: `200`, and the inbox link is `http://localhost:38617/_console/system/approvals`, which answers `200`.
</details>

Root mount: no boot on this tree serves the Console at `/`. `createConsoleStaticPlugin` always mounts at `CONSOLE_PATH` (`/_console`), and `os serve` passes no `uiBasePath` to `AuthPlugin`, so it is always `/_console` there. A deployment that serves the Console at `/` tells the platform through `AuthConfig.uiBasePath: '/'`. That case is pinned at the service with the auth composer's exact composition: the link stays `BASE/system/approvals?request=ID`. Not measured on a real boot, because no boot here can produce it.

## Tests

- `approval-service.test.ts`, new top-level describe "Console page links carry the Console mount": e-mail link under `/_console`, under `/`, the action page's inbox href under both, and no auth service (the e-mail link as before, the inbox link `BASE/system/approvals`).
- `public-base-url.test.ts`, `consolePageLink`: composer origin ignored, root mount, shared sub-path, no base, and no composer / undefined / throws / not a URL.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals typecheck`: exit 0, test-typecheck debt held. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: 126 files, 1817 tests passed.

Ablations (src-imported suite, both legs through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a disk-verified mutation and a HEAD-blob restore):

- Mount dropped (`${publicBaseUrl}${pagePath}`): the `/_console` e-mail pin and the action-page pin go red (2 failed / 2 passed). The root and no-auth pins stay green.
- Mount hard-coded (`${publicBaseUrl}/_console${pagePath}`): the root pin, the action-page pin and the no-auth pin go red (3 failed / 1 passed).
- Restored: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob `1e946f96f358` equal to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- With no auth service in the kernel (for example `os serve` in production without `OS_AUTH_SECRET`, where `AuthPlugin` is skipped), there is no mount to read: the e-mail link stays as before, and the inbox link becomes `BASE/system/approvals` (it was the origin-relative `/system/approvals`). Nobody can sign in to such a deployment's Console, so its approvals inbox cannot be used anyway.
- With no `publicBaseUrl` the e-mail link is still relative, now under the mount (`/_console/system/approvals?...`) when the auth service answers; the inbox link is then the relative `/_console/system/approvals`.

## Verification

First files to read, by risk:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/public-base-url.ts`, `consoleMountPath`: the base-path strip is the one subtle line.
2. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approvals-plugin.ts`: the lazy auth reader, and the raw-app mount's inbox href.
3. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, the `approvalUrl` hunk in `notify()`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/approval-service.test.ts -t "Console page links carry the Console mount"` shows 4 passed.
